AMD FidelityFX SDK 1.1.4 (download FidelityFX-SDK-v1.1.4): SSSR 1.5.0, Denoiser 1.3.0 (reflections).
https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK
Copied unmodified, a subset:
  gpu/       sdk/include/FidelityFX/gpu: ffx_core (HLSL path), sssr/ (no depth downsample / SPD),
             denoiser/ reflections only. Veach compiles these to WGSL with its own callbacks (shaders/Sssr).
  host/      sdk/src/components/{sssr,denoiser} and host headers: porting reference for src/render/sssr;
             samplerBlueNoise..._1spp.cpp is the source of the sobol / scrambling tables.
  hlsl/      sdk/src/backends/dx12/shaders pass wrappers: per-pass binding reference.
  docs/      docs/techniques/stochastic-screen-space-reflections.md and denoiser.md (images omitted).
  LICENSE.txt (MIT).
